_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Acceptance Description Sheets (ADS)
summary: The Acceptance Description Sheet records production methods and inspection results, aiding quality determination, process comparison, trouble investigation, and future surveillance of propellants or explosives.
use_relationship:
The Acceptance and Description Sheet is a record showing the method of production and the results of inspection performed. In general, description sheets assist in the performance of such functions as determining the quality of propellants or explosives, comparing and evaluating the processes of various loading plans producing the same item, investigating the cause of trouble, and facilitating future surveillance and renovation.

The data contains the format and preparation instructions for the data product generated by the discrete task requirements specified in MIL-STD-1171, and associated Appendix.

The WARP User's manual can be accessed at https://mhpwarp.redstone.army.mil.

preparation_instructions.title: Format and Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Acceptance Description sheets shall be in accordance with MIL-STD-1171 and the WARP User's Manual.
